issue.title: Docs
issue.body:
We need a unified documentation and documentation framework.

## As a first iteration we require:

#### User Guides
- [x] Executor
- [x] Operators for Expectation Values
- [x] Quantum Feature Maps
- [x] Quantum Kernel Methods
- [x] #115

#### Overview Pages
(context and a bit background, in class docstrings)
- [x] Executor
- Classifiers
    - [x] QSVC
    - [x] QGPC
    - [x] QNNClassifier
- Regressors
    - [x] QSVR
    - [x] QKRR
    - [x] QGPR
    - [x] QNNRegressor

#### Building Block Documentation
(minimal example + visualisation)
- [x] Operators
- [x] Feature Maps

#### Minimal docstrings
(just short description and parameters)
- for everything that is not listed in Overview Pages

#### Examples
- [x] #116
- [x] Mnist Classification with PQK
- [x] #118
- [x] #117
